analyst_view.overall: PSG are 2nd of the league phase with 12 points from 4 games after beating Nice 3-2; Roma are 23rd with 4 points and need results, though they are second in Serie A and won 5-1 at Parma. PSG are without Doue and Kvaratskhelia (both counted); French reports on Tuesday had Dembele, Marquinhos and Nuno Mendes back and Dembele starting, but one injury list today still has all three out, so their fitness is not fully clear. Roma miss Pellegrini and Rensch (counted), while Balerdi passed a late fitness test and goalkeeper Svilar is listed as a doubt by one page. Swedish referee Glenn Nyberg (about 3.5 cards a game) is named and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals (2.2 PSG, 1.4 Roma), already taking off Doue and Kvaratskhelia and lifting both sides for strong scoring runs. Reports conflict on whether Dembele starts, and Roma's Malen is in form, so nothing clear moves the total; I stay at 3.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners, 5.4 for PSG. PSG should have most of the ball against Gasperini's man-marking side, which the numbers already reflect, so I stay at 9.0.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards, already taking 10% off for Nyberg's record and both sides' calm recent runs. Roma's man-to-man pressing can bring fouls, but that is part of their record, so I stay at 3.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.3 shots, 21.6 for PSG, lifted for both sides' recent shooting. PSG's shot volume holds up even without Doue and Kvaratskhelia, so I stay at 32.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 13.2 on target, already lifted a lot for PSG's recent accuracy (+22%). If Dembele does not start that could dip, but the reports conflict, so I stay with the numbers.
